entities.summary: Paul Frederic Bowles was an American composer, author, and translator. He became associated with the Moroccan city of Tangier, where he settled in 1947 and lived for 52 years to the end of his life. Paul Bowles was a poets & playwrights from Queens (1910-12-30, Queens–1999-11-18). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
